title: XXV Zegama Aizkorri Mendi Maratoia — course page
claims: The official race page describes a medium mountain route over the Aratz massif and the Sierra of Aizkorri which includes the four highest peaks in the Basque Autonomous Region (Aratz, Aizkorri, Aketegi).
The same page gives the course as 42.195 km with 14 control points and 13 refreshment points.
The same page gives accumulated height gain as 5,472 m, maximum altitude 1,551 m at Aketegi and minimum altitude 296 m at Zegama.
The same page gives the technical percentage of the course as approximately 50% and the time limit as 8 hours.
The same page lists a flying sprint at Aizkorri at km 22.58.
The same page lists course records of 3:36:40 by Kilian Jornet Burgada (2022, men) and 4:16:43 by Nienke Brinkman (2022, women).
The same page gives the 2026 race date as 17 May 2026 with a 09:00 start, and calls the 2026 edition the XXV Zegama Aizkorri Mendi Maratoia.
The same page describes the route as very technical and of a high level of difficulty, combining beech forests, steep rocky slopes and high grazing land.
The same page publishes a closing-time table with 11 control rows, from Ulzama at km 8.5 (10:25, 85 min) through Sancti Spiritu at km 19.6 (12:15, 195 min) to Zegama at km 42.20 (17:00, 480 min).
The same page embeds a YouTube video titled '3D ROUTE' (Golden Trail World Series / 2019 / Zegama Race Specs) and, at the time of access, offered no downloadable race GPX.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取赛事官网英文赛道页全文，抄录距离、爬升、海拔、技术比例、时限、飞行冲刺、纪录与 2026 届次。页面日期栏有一处排版错误写作 'May 17, 20256'，同页其他位置与规则页均写 2026。
